name: Felicity Beaumont
source:
Felicity is 20 years old, of very slim physique and with naturally blonde long hair that she dyes pink, due to a desire to feel superior via garnering attention, since her very early school days, in retaliation to Ashley dying her hair blonde after she called it gross, dirty and ugly. She and her clone Emma grew up together in an extremely wealthy but horribly strict family, instilling virtues of ego, arrogance, stepping on others to get what you want, et cetera. It comes as no surprise that they were bullies throughout their school life, being the most popular girls but with no actual friends to speak of, which only fed into Felicity's need for attention. She was always in charge, while Emma acted as her sidekick, following her actions both out of habit and a need to fit in with her only friend and ally. They were thus extremely close, doing everything together both in and out of school, Felicity even brushing Emma's hair every morning, a caring side to her very rarely seen even to her own clone.

Her father owned her school, and later the community college she attends, which he is the dean of. While she and Emma fear him due to his unloving and downright cruel nature, some of his traits have rubbed off to a mild degree on them regardless, such as his extreme hatred of elves, which they regard as dim-witted and unhygienic, only compounded due to their wealthy upbringing, where typically elf-employed jobs are done by human butlers and servants. Their family's only elves worked as gardeners and carpenters, and were not allowed inside the main house. Having such high and strict expectations to be perfect while being told she's above everyone else led her to become little more than a spoiled brat and bully, scared on the inside but prideful and spiteful on the outside.
